title: Provide browser services
responsibility: Create and retrieve page-scoped API, session and project services through Svelte context.

outputs.name: provideBrowser
outputs.description: The new HostedBrowser this call builds and stores under key with setContext, so browserContext can read it: api is built by browserApi(fetch, failure handler), session by createSessionStore(browserAuth(api)), and projects by browserProjects(api). A failure whose status is 401 starts session.refresh() only when session.actor is set, and the refresh promise is discarded with void, so a rejected refresh is not caught here.

outputs.name: browserContext
outputs.description: The same HostedBrowser object that provideBrowser stored under key in the component context that getContext reads. Nothing checks that a provider ran, so if none did, the result is whatever getContext returns for key, which the declared HostedBrowser type does not reflect.

errors.name: Browser context accessed outside Svelte initialization
errors.description: Thrown by Svelte when provideBrowser (through setContext) or browserContext (through getContext) runs outside component initialization; neither function catches it.
